newsitem.title: USA: Collaborative Clinical to roll out DataTRAK.
newsitem.headline: Collaborative Clinical to roll out DataTRAK.

text.p: Collaborative Clinical Research Inc said Friday it and and IBM Global Services, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, have agreed to roll out their jointly developed DataTRAK management systems in North America starting in April.
The target roll-out rate is 30 installations a month, including Thinkpads and printers, the company said.
Collaborative Clinical and IBM signed a technology alliance in July, 1996, to develop the DataTRAK management systems for clinical trial projects.
The company said it first would install the technology within its own affiliated site network and may invest up to $1 million during 1997 as part of that effort.
The DataTRAK beta test is scheduled to be completed in May, 1997, at which point the company said it expects to market the product.
The company also said it would post "nominal" royalty income before June 30, 1997, from sales of software and support used in demonstrations to clients.
